stem.en: A recessive condition is carried by a gene on the X chromosome. Why does this condition appear far more often in men than in women, unlike an autosomal recessive condition?
stem.et: Retsessiivset seisundit kannab geen X-kromosoomil. Miks esineb see seisund meestel palju sagedamini kui naistel, erinevalt autosomaalsest retsessiivsest seisundist?

label.en: Because men have only one X chromosome, so a single recessive allele on it is always expressed with no second copy to mask it, while women need two copies (one on each X chromosome) to show the same phenotype.
label.et: Sest meestel on ainult üks X-kromosoom, mistõttu üksainus retsessiivne alleel sellel avaldub alati, ilma teise koopiata, mis seda varjaks, samas kui naised vajavad sama fenotüübi avaldumiseks kahte koopiat (üht kummalgi X-kromosoomil).

label.en: It doesn't — X-linked recessive conditions actually affect men and women at the same rate, just like autosomal recessive conditions do.
label.et: See ei ole nii -- X-seotud retsessiivsed seisundid mõjutavad tegelikult mehi ja naisi sama sagedusega, samamoodi nagu autosomaalsed retsessiivsed seisundid.

label.en: Because the recessive allele on the X chromosome happens to be more common in the general population than the dominant allele.
label.et: Sest retsessiivne alleel X-kromosoomil on üldpopulatsioonis juhtumisi sagedasem kui domineeriv alleel.

label.en: Because traits carried on the X chromosome blend between the mother's and father's contributions, producing an intermediate result that appears more often in men.
label.et: Sest X-kromosoomil kantavad tunnused seguvad ema ja isa panuse vahel, andes vahepealse tulemuse, mis ilmneb sagedamini meestel.
